command: set -euo pipefail; for unit in frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; do echo UNIT=$unit; pid=$(systemctl --user show $unit -p MainPID --value); echo PID=$pid; if [ "$pid" != 0 ] && [ -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ]; then printf 'CMDLINE='; tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$pid/cmdline; echo; ps -p $pid -o lstart=,etime=; fi; systemctl --user show $unit -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ExecStart --no-pager; done; echo '--- VOICE STATUS BEST-EFFORT ---'; PY=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/stern.py; if [ -f "$PY" ]; then python3 "$PY" gespraech-status-lesen 2>&1 || true; fi; echo '--- ACTIVE FLOOR CACHE ---'; if [ -f "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/frankenstein/omega_organ_activity.json" ]; then cat "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/frankenstein/omega_organ_activity.json"; else echo NONE; fi
